name: world-news-digest
description: Fetch world news RSS feeds and create a daily digest for Discord

steps.name: fetch-rss-feeds
steps.prompt:
Fetch the following RSS feeds using the fetch tool and extract all articles published in the last 24 hours:

1. BBC News: https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml
2. CNN: https://rss.cnn.com/rss/edition.rss
3. Reuters: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/topNews
4. The Guardian: https://feeds.theguardian.com/theguardian/rss
5. Al Jazeera: https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml

For each feed, extract: title, publication date, and description/summary.
If a feed fails to load, skip it and note it as unavailable.
Return a raw list of all articles found, grouped by source.

steps.name: summarize-digest
steps.prompt:
You are a professional news editor. Today is {{input}}.

Using the articles below, create a concise World News Digest.

Rules:
- Include only articles from the last 24 hours
- Deduplicate: if multiple sources cover the same story, merge them
- Cover maximum 12 stories
- Total length: under 1800 characters (Discord message limit)
- If it would exceed 1800 characters, focus on the top 8 stories

Output format (Discord markdown):
```
**📰 World News Digest — {date}**

**Top Stories**
- **[Headline]** — 2-3 sentence summary. *(Source)*

**Politics & World Affairs**
- **[Headline]** — summary. *(Source)*

**Business & Economy**
- **[Headline]** — summary. *(Source)*

*{N} articles reviewed — OpenFang + Ollama*
```

Articles to summarize:
{{raw_articles}}
